summary: Educational software, open-source pedagogical utilities, interactive simulation tools, and digital learning prototypes.

items.title: BioSim Ph: Philippine Ecological Food Web Simulator
items.subtitle: Interactive web simulation of endemic trophic dynamics for Junior High Science
items.impact: Deployed across 12 public schools in the division; utilized by over 1,400 Grade 7 learners to test species population collapse scenarios without high-spec computing hardware.
items.description: A zero-dependency browser simulation enabling learners to alter producer-consumer biomass ratios in typical Philippine rainforest and mangrove ecosystems.

evidence.label: Software Pilot Evaluation Report
evidence.context: Evaluated by Division ICT coordinators with 4.9/5 usability rating.

items.title: ChemTOS: Bloom's Taxonomy Table of Specifications Generator
items.subtitle: Lightweight client-side assessment matrix calculator for secondary teachers
items.impact: Cut assessment blueprint preparation time from 3 hours to 15 minutes for 45 science department faculty members.
items.description: Calculates percentage distributions, item numbering sequences, and cognitive complexity levels automatically based on DepEd assessment parameters.

evidence.label: LAC Presentation Slide Deck & Commendation
evidence.context: Adopted by the school testing coordinator as the official TOS template.
